programs.title: Disasters Engineered
programs.desc: A towering inferno that killed 72 residents becomes Britain's deadliest fire; a pedestrian bridge collapses in Florida over eight lanes of traffic, killing six people; how can fatal design flaws happen in such important constructions?

programs.title: America's Secret D-Day Disaster
programs.desc: The Allied forces' top-secret rehearsal for D-Day that went wrong.

programs.title: D-Day
programs.desc: A retelling of the D-Day invasion and its critical naval operation involving an armada of diverse and ingenious vessels.

programs.title: D-Day and the Dambusters
programs.desc: How the legendary "Dambuster" bomber squadron of WWII fooled Nazi Germany into believing the Allied invasion was going to be at Calais, rather than Normandy, and went to on to destroy Hitler's super weapons.

programs.title: The Battle of Normandy: 85 Days in Hell
programs.desc: On D-Day, Allied forces land in Normandy, France, to beat back the German troops and liberate France; previously unseen archival footage captures the 85-day struggle to liberate Europe and includes rare images of the battle itself.

programs.title: Liberation: D-Day to Berlin
programs.desc: In 1944, the Allied invasion of Nazi-occupied Europe brings the hope of freedom and the devastation of war to the people of France.
